🚨🇲🇽 <u>A US Republican lobbies Mexico's Senate on who can be president</u>

Larry Rubin — the Republican Party's representative in Mexico, president of the American Society of Mexico and a candidate for the US Congress — is urging Mexican senators to kill Sheinbaum's reform barring dual nationals from the presidency and governorships. Deputies passed it September 22; it now sits in Senate committees. His pitch: senators' loyalty should be "with the Mexican people, not a party."
banner: US GOP MAN LOBBIES MEXICO'S SENATE

text:
🇲🇽🌎 <u>UN orders Mexico to find a young worker taken in Ensenada</u>

The UN Committee on Enforced Disappearances registered urgent action 2388/2026 for Jesús Alexandro Sánchez Gerardo, 24, and asked the Mexican state for immediate measures to find him. On August 20, armed men who identified themselves as Ensenada municipal police pulled him and two coworkers from company dormitories with threats and beatings, per the Cedhapi human rights center. He hasn't been seen since.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>"On Saturdays, no brown people get in"</u>

Audios attributed to Strana, a nightclub in San Pedro Garza García — Mexico's richest municipality — have a staffer asking whether anyone in a group is "de piel morena o negra," because dark-skinned people don't get in on Saturdays. "Sé que suena racista. Porque sí es racista. Así es en Strana." Nuevo León's anti-discrimination council announced an inspection. As Ana María Ibarra writes in Contralínea, almost nobody needed proof to believe it: in 2022 CDMX found Sonora Grill guilty of segregating diners by appearance.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>The UN's refugee chief comes to study Mexico's model</u>

UNHCR's Barham Salih is in Mexico on his first visit, and the Senate receives him Tuesday in a solemn session for the 75th anniversary of the Refugee Convention. The agenda: strengthen Mexico's asylum system and its national integration network. Since 2019 Mexico has registered more than 600,000 asylum applicants — one of the top receiving countries on earth — and 240 companies have already hired refugees.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>200,000 in the Zócalo: "Only the people decide Mexico's destiny"</u>

Sheinbaum closed her Second Report tour Saturday before more than 200,000 people packing the Zócalo, per La Jornada. Two years in, with Trump threatening from the north, the core message was sovereignty: "No queremos intervencionismos." She called this Legislature the 4T's constituent congress — health, housing, education, the 40-hour week and wages above inflation now written into the Constitution.

🇲🇽🛢️ <u>DIESEL TAX STAYS AT ZERO FOR A THIRD WEEK</u>

Hacienda is keeping the IEPS tax on diesel at zero for a third straight week, a stimulus of 7.36 pesos per liter, and raising Magna's relief to 4.83 pesos per liter, 72% of the tax (El Economista). Since the stimulus began in March, the state has given up 108.4 billion pesos so global fuel prices don't land on truckers, farmers and families.
banner: DIESEL TAX: ZERO FOR A 3RD WEEK

🇲🇽🏭 <u>EDOMEX CREATES ONE IN THREE NEW JOBS IN MEXICO</u>

Mexico State leads the country in job creation, with more than 250,000 new formal, IMSS-registered jobs under Governor Delfina Gómez. Ahead of her third government report, she says one in every three jobs created in Mexico comes from Edomex. Foreign investment topped $3.3 billion in autos, logistics, real estate, commerce and food.
banner: EDOMEX: 1 IN 3 NEW JOBS IN MEXICO

text:
🇲🇽⚖️ <u>TO LEAD MEXICO, YOU HAVE TO BE ONLY MEXICAN</u>

Deputies passed Sheinbaum's reform 344 to 116: anyone running for president, governor or Mexico City head of government must give up any second nationality. The opposition voted no. Sheinbaum: "I really don't understand how a Mexican, a Mexican deputy, doesn't agree that to be president you can only be Mexican." Dual nationality for Mexicans abroad is untouched. The rule applies only to those seeking the top offices.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>SHEINBAUM ANSWERS TRUMP'S UN "EPICENTER" LINE</u>

At the UN General Assembly, Trump called Mexico the "epicenter" of cartel violence and claimed criminal groups control its territory. Sheinbaum said Mexico won't accept being blamed unilaterally for drug trafficking, then added: "I could also say it's hard to live next to a country with such high drug consumption, or with so much weapons production, but I won't say it because we have a good relationship."
banner: SHEINBAUM TO TRUMP: YOUR DRUGS, YOUR GUNS

text:
🇲🇽🏭 <u>DATA CENTERS DRINK QUERÉTARO'S WATER DURING A DROUGHT</u>

Oxfam Mexico warns that data centers are spreading faster than tax and environmental rules can keep up. In Querétaro, where more than 90% of the state was in drought in 2024 and 2025, a single data center holds permits to pump up to 25 million liters from wells, while communities in Colón and El Marqués suffer water and power cuts. Oxfam calls it a new dependency between central and peripheral countries, this time digital.
banner: DATA CENTERS: 25M LITERS IN A DROUGHT
